name: FFmpeg Reality Checks
playlistTitle: FFmpeg Reality Checks: What Your Command Really Did
playlistDescription:
Short narrated experiments on one question each: what did that FFmpeg command really do? Every episode runs on a synthetic test video, measures the result frame by frame, and ships a fixture and tests so you can rerun it.

Source, fixtures and tests: github.com/mizcausevic-dev/ffmpeg-reality-checks

Miz Causevic, Kinetic Gain LLC
